(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore is a tight fit (tolerance band 0.018 mm) on a zinc-plated part, but the drawing does not account for plating thickness in the dimension or provide a note to re-machine after plating. The added coating will reduce the bore size and may prevent assembly with the mating shaft. The designer should either adjust the pre-plate bore tolerance to allow for the specified I.Z.B.P. thickness or add a note requiring the hole to be finished after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the ⌀16 H7 bore is to be machined after plating, or increase the bore size/tolerance to compensate for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
